W.note: Full-featured tracker with copy, mark delivered and an add form, but the open state is very tall at rest and the panel snaps open and shut with no height transition.

X.note: A tight 52px collapsed row and a smooth grid-row expand with an inert panel, Escape-to-collapse, live status and an exception flow with clear next steps.

Y.note: Polished collapse and exception block, but the toast never shows the package name, carrier or tracking number, so its tracking job is thin.

Z.note: A compact multi-package bar, but the panel pops open with no transition and the tracking number is masked with no copy action.
